title: Tests seed ./test-books.db but app defaults to ./books.db
evidence: src/index.test.ts:7 opens getDb('./test-books.db'), but src/database.ts:4 default is './books.db' and src/index.ts:13 calls getDb() with no path — so the app under test writes to books.db, not the seeded test db
suggestion: Make the DB path configurable via env var and point both the app and tests at the same temp/test DB, or use an in-memory ':memory:' DB for tests

title: Integration tests persist to an on-disk SQLite file with no teardown
evidence: src/index.ts:13 initDb() opens './books.db'; no afterAll cleanup removes the file, so state can leak between runs
suggestion: Use ':memory:' for tests or delete the db file in an afterAll hook to keep runs deterministic
